solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: One note over crime involving a particular South-East Asian

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
something over is done, finished

indicators.note: involving means the word for crime takes the a inside it

parts.note: a sin is a wrongdoing, a crime in the moral sense

explanation.surface: A record of one misdeed pinned on someone from that region.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involving' puts A inside SIN to give SIAN at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A person from Indonesia is a particular South-East Asian, a national of that archipelago.

clue.text: Regarding restraint in getting promoted

indicators.note: getting promoted means the letters in move up to the top of this down entry

parts.note: a rein is a strap that restrains a horse, so a restraint

explanation.surface: Holding back while climbing the ladder at work.
explanation.walkthrough: In REIN, the IN moves to the front: 'promoted' means raised, i.e. to the top in a down answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin legal phrase means in the matter of, a formal way to say concerning or about.

clue.text: Nemesis of warrior called up to secure line

indicators.note: to secure means the word for called holds the letter for line inside it
up in a down clue means the letters are read from bottom to top

parts.note: to have hailed someone is to have called to them

explanation.surface: A soldier's foe was phoned and told to secure the front line.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to secure' puts L in HAILED for HALILED; 'up' reverses it.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Bible the woman who cut Samson's hair betrayed the mighty warrior, so she was his downfall.

clue.text: Money lost in the crash?

parts.note: the crash is a car accident, after which a driver who claims on insurance forfeits a premium discount

explanation.surface: Reads like a question about savings wiped out in a stock market crash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crash' suggests a financial collapse, but it is a car accident.
explanation.definitionFit: Drivers who make no insurance claims earn a premium discount, which is lost after an accident.

clue.text: Beautiful women, foremost of them amongst beach worshippers?

indicators.note: amongst places the chosen letter inside the word for beach worshippers

parts.note: sunners are sun worshippers lying on a beach

indicators.note: foremost of picks the first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: Attractive women lead the crowd of sunbathers on the sand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'foremost of' gives T from 'them'; 'amongst' sets it inside SUNNERS.
explanation.definitionFit: Strikingly attractive people are called stunners, a colloquial term for beauties.

clue.text: A radiance without repeated element, pale in colour

indicators.note: without means the letter in question is taken out

parts.note: a sheen is a shine or radiance
the doubled E in the word for radiance is the repeated element, one copy dropped

explanation.surface: A glow lacking some chemical element turns washed-out.
explanation.walkthrough: SHEEN has a double E; 'without' removes one, leaving A SHEN.
explanation.definitionFit: A face drained of colour, grey like ash, is described as pale.

clue.text: Celebrity opening cut short

indicators.note: cut short says the word for opening loses its final letter

parts.note: an opening is a start, a beginning

explanation.surface: A famous person's premiere is abruptly curtailed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut short' drops the last T of START.
explanation.definitionFit: A famous performer or personality is called a star, the usual synonym for a celebrity.

clue.text: Hard to leave location of show by energy drink supplier

indicators.note: to leave says the letter for hard departs from the word for show venue

parts.note: a theatre is where a show is put on
H is the pencil-grading abbreviation for hard
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A tough performer leaves the venue and heads to a supplier of energy drinks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to leave' removes H from THEATRE, giving TEATRE. The definition is cryptic: the bush supplies tea in name, though tea trees give oil.
explanation.definitionFit: Read playfully, a shrub named for tea is the plant that yields that drink.

clue.text: Thinking a lot of relaxation, conserving muscle

indicators.note: conserving means keeping the muscle word safe inside

parts.note: resting is relaxation
pec is short for pectoral, a chest muscle

explanation.surface: Lots of rest preserves the body's muscles.
explanation.definitionFit: To hold someone in high esteem is to think a lot of them, the sense of admiring.

clue.text: Museum exhibit — going again, missing time at college

indicators.note: missing says the word for going again is without the letter for time

parts.note: a fire that is going again has been relit

explanation.surface: An old object resumes its tour after a gap in someone's university days.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going again' looks like a resumption of travel, but it describes a fire lit once more; 'missing' drops the time letter from it.
explanation.definitionFit: An old object surviving from the past is the kind of item a museum puts on show.

clue.text: Revolutionary has value seizing power in times of change

indicators.note: seizing means the rearranged letters grab the letter for power inside them
revolutionary signals the words has value are turned over into a new order

parts.note: P is the physics symbol for power

explanation.surface: A rebel's worth grows when he grabs control in turbulent days.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Revolutionary' shuffles HAS VALUE into UHEAVALS; 'seizing' takes P in after the U.
explanation.definitionFit: Violent or sudden disruptions bring periods of great change in society.

clue.text: Restless pair connected, likely to fall head over heels?

definitions.text: likely to fall head over heels?

indicators.note: restless letters will not stay still, so the words pair connected are reordered

explanation.surface: An agitated couple joined together, about to tumble into love.
explanation.walkthrough: 'head over heels' suggests falling in love, but here it means literally tumbling.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone forever having mishaps and tumbles is prone to accidents, given to falling over.

clue.text: What makes geometry difficult to get into?

definitions.text: What makes geometry difficult to get into?

parts.words: What makes geometry difficult to get into?
parts.note: a cryptic reading: a subject difficult to master has a steep graph of progress, and geometry is all about curves

explanation.surface: A student wonders why geometry is so hard to begin.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue plays on the curve as a shape studied in geometry and as the graph of how fast someone acquires a skill.
explanation.definitionFit: The graph of progress while acquiring a skill is steep when a subject is hard to start.

clue.text: Asp certain to be peculiar pet

indicators.note: to be peculiar means the letters of asp certain are made strange, rearranged

explanation.surface: A snake is certain to be an odd choice of household pet.
explanation.definitionFit: A long-haired domestic breed of feline is a popular example of a household pet.

clue.text: Musical work (with change of vocal lead) about limit in short-term stuff

indicators.note: about means the altered work goes round the word for limit
the first vowel, a lead singer's sound, is changed for another vowel

parts.note: an opera is a musical work for the stage
a hem is an edge or limit of cloth

explanation.surface: An opera with a new lead singer is given only a short run.
explanation.walkthrough: 'vocal lead' is the first vowel of the work, O, which becomes E; 'about' wraps that altered word round HEM.
explanation.definitionFit: Things of only passing use or interest, meant to last a short while, are collected as ephemera.

clue.text: Coming period of history has Nationalist kept in check

parts.note: AD, Anno Domini, labels the era of the Christian calendar

indicators.note: kept in means the letter for Nationalist is held inside the word for check

parts.note: to vet is to check or examine

explanation.surface: A history lesson about a time when a nationalist movement was held back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'kept in' puts N inside VET to make VENT.
explanation.definitionFit: An arrival or coming into being is an advent, as in the coming of a new age.

clue.text: Clangorous factory used to hide dope

indicators.note: used to hide means the factory word conceals the dope word inside it

parts.note: a plant is an industrial works or factory
gen is slang for information, like dope

explanation.surface: A noisy factory is used as cover for hiding drugs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dope' looks like drugs, but it means inside information, GEN.
explanation.definitionFit: A loud, resonant, mournful ringing sound is plangent, much like a clangorous one.

clue.text: Stone garment is light (unsettling, perhaps)

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for stone, the weight
a robe is a long garment

explanation.surface: A heavy item of clothing is surprisingly light, which is a little disturbing.
explanation.definitionFit: A flashing lamp used in clubs can be disorientating, a light that may unsettle.

clue.text: Vehicle rising in speed for competition

indicators.note: in places the turned vehicle inside the word for speed

parts.note: rate is speed, as in a rate of knots

indicators.note: rising in a down clue means the letters read upwards, back to front

parts.note: a car is a vehicle

explanation.surface: A car moving up through the field at pace in a race.
explanation.definitionFit: The fierce struggle for success in working life is a contest, a form of competition.

clue.text: Part of ship's deck not backing marine life

parts.note: a plank is one board of a ship's deck

indicators.note: backing means the word not is read backwards

explanation.surface: A deck board is unrepaired, out in the ocean.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' turns NOT into TON.
explanation.definitionFit: Tiny drifting organisms in the sea form a major part of marine life.

clue.text: Knight in brown work garment

indicators.note: in places the knight abbreviation inside the other letters

parts.note: tan is a light brown
op is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: A knight dressed in brown working clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: The knight is KT, the honours abbreviation, not the chess N or K, and 'in' sends it inside the brown-plus-work string.
explanation.definitionFit: A sleeveless knitted pullover worn over a shirt is an item of clothing.

clue.text: Military order, one following special degree of concentration

indicators.note: following puts the word for one after the abbreviation for special

parts.note: Attention! is the parade-ground command to stand upright
an means one, the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A sergeant barks a command, and one soldier then marches out with particular care.
explanation.definitionFit: How long someone can keep focus is measured as a span of time, so it is a degree of concentration.

clue.text: Completely wrong about North America

indicators.note: about means the word for wrong goes round the North America letters

parts.note: ill means wrong or bad, as in ill-gotten

explanation.surface: Someone is utterly mistaken about the United States and Canada.
explanation.definitionFit: Taken altogether, in total, the phrase means entirely or wholly.

clue.text: Examine small jug

parts.note: a can is a vessel, like a jug

explanation.surface: Inspect a little pitcher.
explanation.definitionFit: To look over something closely or survey it is to examine it.

clue.text: High-quality end to game — it's the fellow in form

parts.note: class means top quality, as in a class act
checkmate, mate, ends a game of chess

explanation.surface: A fine finish to a match, praised as the work of a teammate.
explanation.walkthrough: A form is a British school class, so the fellow in form is a fellow pupil.
explanation.definitionFit: A fellow pupil in the same school class or form is a schoolfellow.

clue.text: Part 1's about following circular form of the eye

indicators.note: following puts the abbreviation for part after the circle letter

parts.note: O is a circular shape
1 is the Roman numeral I, and the 's (has) leads on to what follows
C, circa, means about

explanation.surface: A number in a part has to do with the round shape of the eye.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to sight or the eye is the adjective's sense, as in the optic nerve.

clue.text: About to replace core part of track (a long path)

indicators.note: says the word for about takes the place of the middle letters of the word track

parts.note: re means about, regarding

explanation.surface: An instruction to swap the central stretch of a railway line for a lengthy trail.
explanation.walkthrough: The middle letters RAC of TRACK give way to RE.
explanation.definitionFit: A long, arduous journey on foot is a trek, a lengthy route or path to follow.

clue.text: Company actor accepting line, dismissing a fixation on line?

indicators.note: accepting means the company abbreviation takes the letter for line inside it
dismissing says the word for actor loses the letter a

parts.note: a thespian is an actor

explanation.surface: A theatre company's actor takes a line but drops another, obsessed with the script.
explanation.walkthrough: 'accepting' gives CLO; 'dismissing' removes A from THESPIAN. The definition plays on washing line: a peg fixes clothes there.
explanation.definitionFit: A peg used to fix laundry on a washing line is a fastener for drying clothes.
